<span id="一、概述"></span>
# 1. Overview

Define and manage business optimization goals through an "optimization plan" to help you better design experiments and track results.


| |Definition |Usage scenario |
|---|---|---|
|Optimization plan |A business development goal/product optimization plan that can be accurately defined and measured, including:<br><br><br>* Introduce the business background and describe the optimization plan in this direction.<br><br>* Identify which metrics can be used to measure effectiveness. |Discover data problems through BI reports, UBA analysis tools, user insights, user research, etc., and define an optimization plan.<br><br>Such as: increase live broadcast revenue, increase new users login rate. |
|Sub\-target |There are many paths to complete an optimization plan, and a sub\-target is a measure of how one is achieved.<br><br><br>* The optimization plan and sub\-targets have a 1: n relationship.<br><br>* The success criteria of measurement metrics are given for different sub\-targets. |After having the optimization plan, it can be broken down into multiple sub\-targets to implement optimization and run experiments.<br><br>For example, for "increasing the login rate of new users", we can formulate:<br><br><br>* Sub\-target 1: New user red packet activity to promote login (expected + 20%)<br><br>* Sub\-target 2: Optimize login button copy (expected + 2%)<br><br>* Sub\-target 3: Increase landing page access (expected + 5%) |

<span id="二、如何使用"></span>
# How to use

<span id="功能入口"></span>
## Function entrance


* From "Business Analysis" \- \> "Plans", you can access the optimization plan list page, which supports filtering by status, searching by plan name and description. The list is divided into 3 modules:

   * My plans: Optimization plans of the personnel holds responsibility, which includes me.

   * Shared with me: Optimization plans of partners which include me.

   * Other plans: Optimization plans that are not relevant to me, but can still be viewed and referenced.

* The optimization plan has three states and is presented in the following order:

   * In progress: enter this state when the creation is completed.

   * Completed: All sub\-targets have a conclusion (achieved, basically achieved, not achieved), that is, completed.

   * Terminated: After clicking the Terminate button, it has been terminated, and the completed plan cannot be terminated.


<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/c3daaaa9e12a4216a20a11c21096ddfd~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

<span id="创建优化计划"></span>
## Create an optimization plan


* Click "New Optimization Plan" to enter the new page, which is divided into two steps.

   * Define the business optimization plan: name, description, responsible person, partners, and metrics.

   * Add objectives: name, define metric achievement criteria. The "core metric" will become the core metric of the objective correlation experiment, and the system will automatically determine whether the objective is achieved with this metric.


<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/5f3efedeb299477d806899b87cf8e56a~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/e00add02364d450fb299c42ce0f87ab9~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

<span id="优化计划详情"></span>
## Optimization plan details


1. ### Overall metric monitoring   <span id="overall-metric-monitoring"></span>

* Show the change trend of the optimization plan measurement metrics under the full DAU through the data dashboard.

   * Metrics: Success metrics are displayed by default, and switching is supported.

   * Time interval: The latest week's data is displayed by default, and modification is supported.

   * Filtering conditions: support for dimensional filtering and multi\-dimensional disassembly.

      <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/3b76118847cc4893a77c491e92d12027~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

2. ### Create/bind experiments for sub\-targets/objectives   <span id="create-bind-experiments-for-sub-targets-objectives"></span>

* Click "Create Experiment" to automatically jump to the experiment creation process, and automatically pre\-fill the core metrics, non\-core metrics, and other attention metrics of the objective. After the experiment is created, it will be automatically associated with the list of experiments corresponding to the objective.


<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/fd7f2b0a53304dd791cba10cda80456e~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>


* Click "Binding Experiment" to call out the experiment selection pop\-up window. Only experiments that are consistent with the core metrics of the sub\-target are supported, but if the core metrics of the experiment are modified, the binding will be automatically lifted.


<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/305fbf36dd904566a9df9a616d62e707~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>


3. ### Add sub\-target   <span id="add-sub-target"></span>

* After clicking "Create sub\-target", you can add sub\-targets for existing optimization plans. An optimization plan can contain multiple sub\-targets without limit


<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/c09336c2bcc64aa38267550718af543a~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

<span id="6680308c"></span>
### Monitor the completion of sub\-targets

<div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip" data-tips-is-title="true">tip</div>


<div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip">Seven days after the correlation experiment was started, DataTester tested the experimental data and generated data results such as the winning experimental group and metrics.</div>



* Each sub\-target is presented as a card and contains the following information and action items:

   * Sub\-target name

   * Action buttons: edit, delete, terminate

   * Core/non\-core metrics achievement criteria

   * Sub\-target effect status: Automatically calculate the effect according to the percentage improvement of the core/non\-core metrics of the bound experiment automatically extracted. Only if there is a binding experiment that meets the standard.

      <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/e2dd58ceeb054eaf976e460c2180e3fc~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

* Select a subtarget to view its associated experiments and their metrics.

   * Outstanding group: the group that performed best on the core metric of the experiment.

   * Performance of sub\-objective measures in each experiment: rate of change, confidence level compared to control group.

   * Click "View Report" to open a new page for details.

      <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/ca03f626053d44f1a8852e63c0f8c1fe~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>
